casio3_melting_2.name: Melting of CaSiO3 - Level 2
casio3_melting_2.description: Simulate the melting of wollastonite CaSiO3 by first equilibrating the system under NVT conditions, then relaxing it under NPT conditions, followed by a heating stage under NPT where the temperature is gradually increased to induce melting. Use the reaxff potential. Ensure charge equilibration is included using fix qeq/reaxff, compatible with reaxff. The simulation should replicate the unit cell 2 times in each direction. Detect the solid → liquid phase transition during the heating stage and report the mean-square displacement (MSD) of atoms at the transition point in Å².
